scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:inspect:lessons: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT id, course_id, module_id, title, status, created_at, updated_at FROM lessons ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:inspect:queue: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT id, lesson_id, workspace_id, learner_id, status, due_at, delivered_at, attempts, max_attempts, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at FROM lesson_queue ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:inspect:audit: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT id, actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, status, metadata_json, created_at FROM audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run predeploy && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run predeploy && npx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.migrate:staging: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging
scripts.migrate:production: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production
